title: Option to hide .lnk extension on shortcut files
body: The app displays the shortcut .lnk extension even if the settings to hide extensions in file explorer are enabled. It would be nice to have an option to disable showing the .lnk extension or all extensions. Other than that, I really like the app.
author: stiw91

title: Title text alignment is broken
body: Not sure if you meant to fully revert this or if it was accidental and an incomplete restore? The setting shows in the frame settings and is persisted correctly but has no effect on the title text display.
author: btigi

comments.body: It was accidental. I fixed it! :)
